atAGlance: Hủ tiếu chay is vegetarian hủ tiếu noodle soup, usually with clear broth, rice noodles, tofu, mushrooms, greens, and herbs.
whatItIs: Hủ tiếu chay is southern-style rice noodle soup made vegetarian with tofu, mushrooms, vegetables, herbs, and a light sweet-savory broth.
howToEnjoy: Taste the broth first, then add herbs, lime, and chili slowly. Ask about fish sauce if you need a strict vegetarian bowl.
howLocalsOrder: Order hủ tiếu chay when you want a lighter vegetarian noodle soup. Say không nước mắm if fish-sauce seasoning is a concern.
worthKnowing: Hủ tiếu is a southern noodle-shop staple, and chay versions often lean on mushrooms and tofu for depth.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the broth is vegetable-based; hủ tiếu shops may keep pork or seafood broth for standard bowls.
travelerCaution: Confirm the broth is vegetarian if strict.
